descriptions.inProgress: After coming back from hunting Stumps, Mai thought I had some talent, and proceeded to turn up the training by a notch. This time, I'll have to hunt #r5 Red Snails#k. Apparently they are faster than Stumps, so I better watch out. \n\nRed Snail #r#a10421##k
descriptions.completed: Red Snails have much higher endurance than Snails and Blue Snails. They also move faster than Stumps. I better not underestimate those sneaky creatures.
